title: 氚云 MCP 对接配置
description: 连接您的 氚云 账号，支持快速创建应用表单、管理业务数据、以流程驱动审批与任务流转。Token 和 Base Url 仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy 下。
description_en: Connect your H3Yun account, it supports rapid app creation, business data management, and workflow-driven approvals and task routing. Token and Base URL are stored only locally under ~/.workbuddy.
docLabel: 如何获取 氚云 个人Token？
docLabel_en: How to get H3Yun personal token?

fields.label: 个人Token
fields.placeholder: 在 氚云个人信息 → 用户访问凭证 → 管理凭证 中生成
fields.placeholder_en: Generate in H3Yun Personal Information → User Access Credentials → Manage Credentials
fields.description: 用于访问 氚云 的个人访问令牌。
